Today, there is an update on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Cyclone Murasu has intensified into a Severe Cyclone, prompting an Orange Alert for Chennai and Tiruvallur. Schools and colleges in these districts are closed today, November 2nd, due to the anticipated heavy rainfall. The cyclone is expected to make landfall in South Andhra Pradesh, near North Coastal Tamil Nadu. The Tamil Nadu government has issued heavy rainfall warnings for seven districts. Tiruvallur experienced very heavy rain yesterday, November 1st, and Chennai and Tiruvallur are expected to receive very heavy rain today. Winds associated with Cyclone Murasu may reach speeds of up to 75 kilometers per hour. A Yellow Alert has also been issued for Coastal Andhra.
